# Monty worker schema

`monty.proto` and `LICENSE` are unchanged from [Monty v1.6.0](https://github.com/pydantic/monty/tree/3f89dcbf82071896efb5e3ded507db4191e8d829), protocol 8. The schema is from `crates/monty-proto/proto/monty/v1/monty.proto`. The npm dependency supplies the matching worker binary. Update them together.
